news.text: #Locatelli Shock: Out For 5-6 MonthsUnderwent surgery in Lyon#Juve in trouble: outer meniscus suture for Manuel. #DouglasLuiz and #Koopmeiners against #Sassuolo.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE PRIDE"THIS IS HOW WE'LL GET THROUGH"No crying over spilled milk: tactical changes, in with the youngsters.#Locatelli has already undergone surgery: out for 6 months? #Boga, it's a biceps femoris lesion: 40-60 days. There are no useful free agents available to sign: #Spalletti expects to adapt. #Woltemade feels ready, #Conceição stakes his claim as a leader. [Front Page TuttoSport]
‼️Recovery times:#Locatelli will be back in 2027 (estimated recovery time 5/6 months). #Boga: around 5 weeks.[Mirko Di Natale]
About a month out for Jeremie #Boga. The tests carried out today revealed a medium-grade lesion of the biceps femoris for the attacking winger. #Juventus[Nico Schira]

#Locatelli has undergone surgery to suture the lateral meniscus of his right knee. Out for 5-6 months.#Boga has suffered a medium-grade lesion of the biceps femoris. Out for approx 5 weeks.#Juventus[Giovanni Albanese]

MEDICAL UPDATE | MANUEL LOCATELLI AND JEREMIE BOGAManuel LocatelliFollowing the sprain to his right knee sustained during the Juventus-Milan match, Manuel Locatelli underwent surgery today to suture the external meniscus of his right knee.The operation, performed by Dr. Bertrand Sonnery-Cottet in the presence of the club's doctor, Dr. Marco Freschi, at the Hôpital Privé Jean Mermoz in Lyon, was a complete success.The player will begin his scheduled rehabilitation program tomorrow.Jérémie BogaThis morning, Jérémie Boga underwent diagnostic tests at J|medical following a muscle problem in his left thigh that he suffered yesterday.The tests revealed a medium-grade tear of the biceps femoris. ❌ Despite the injuries in midfield, #Juventus has no intention of drawing from the free agent mercato. The decision is linked to the squad constraints and the restrictions imposed by the settlement agreement with UEFA, which leave no financial or registration room for maneuver in Serie A and Europe. #Spalletti will therefore try to transform the emergency into a tactical opportunity, testing new ideas and maximizing internal resources.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🎙Cristiano #Giuntoli comments on the situation of the #Juventus midfield:"Right now I'm fully focused on #Atalanta, despite being happy for the players (#Koopmeiners and #DouglasLuiz) whom I signed for #Juve and who now have space to play."[ @CristianoCorbo - @tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

🚑 #Juventus has officially decided to proceed with #Locatelli's meniscus surgery.The intervention will take place in Lyon in the coming hours, where the player was already present to undergo in-depth specialist review.After the operation, a more precise overview of the recovery timeline will be available, but the target is a return no earlier than the beginning of 2027.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

Thought of the Day 💭Kolo Muani hasn't had the desired start to the season, but close to no one remembers that he also had a period of 12 games in his first visit, where he didn't score.This has probably been obscured by the fact that Kolo Muani started his stay in Turin back then very strongly, - he scored in his debut and in general it amounted to 5 goals already within the first 3 matches.Then came the scoring break of 12 games from February 11th to April 23rd. 2 xUCL vs. PSV, 1 x Coppa vs. Empoli and 9 x Serie A matches.At the end of the season, Kolo Muani got his goal scoring going again with 3 goals in 5 matches in Serie A and subsequently with 2 goals in 3 matches at the Club World Cup
📈 With Manuel #Locatelli's injury, the chances of seeing Augusto #Owusu permanently in the first team are on the rise. Plans for him are absolutely confirmed.[Mirko Di Natale]
